description: This file defines the `EmployeeNumber` class, which extends `FilterField` and implements filtering logic for employee number-related queries within the OrangeHRM reporting system. It includes methods for building query conditions, retrieving entity aliases, and converting employee data to an array format.

classes.name: EmployeeNumber
classes.description: A filter field class responsible for applying employee number-related filtering in reports, providing methods to add filtering conditions to a query, retrieve entity aliases, and convert employee data to an array format for reporting purposes.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a SQL WHERE condition to filter employees by their employee number if the operator is EQUAL and the value is set.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the array of entity aliases used in query joins, here returning 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Retrieves employee details by employee number and formats it into an array with ID, label, and termination status for reporting.
